extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, patent attorneys, and IP professionals dealing with Eurasian patents (EAPO Member States)
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of the Eurasian Patent Office functions and procedural components relevant to filing, searching, examining, granting, appealing, and maintaining Eurasian patents, including EAPO's role under the PCT. Useful for applicants and practitioners interacting with EAPO processes and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Main function — receive applications and grant Eurasian patents
rubrics_metrics.description: The main function of the Eurasian Patent Office is to receive applications and to grant Eurasian patents valid on the territory of Member-States of the Eurasian Patent Convention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the primary mandate of EAPO; see linked 'more about Eurasian Patent Procedure' for detailed procedural steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search and Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: EAPO receives Eurasian applications for inventions filed directly to EAPO and under the PCT Procedure; carries out search, examination and other procedures related to applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers both national and PCT-originated filings and includes search and substantive examination functions performed by EAPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant of patents (after substantive examination)
rubrics_metrics.description: After substantive examination EAPO grants patents and publishes information about them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grant is contingent on completion of substantive examination; publication of granted patents is part of the process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeal Procedure (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: EAPO considers appeals against patent grant under procedure of opposition, adopts resolutions and publishes information relating to appeal procedure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opposition/appeal procedures are formalized; EAPO issues resolutions and publishes related information about appeals.

rubrics_metrics.name: PCT International Authority functions
rubrics_metrics.description: Performs the functions of an International Searching Authority and an International Preliminary Examining Authority within the framework of the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EAPO acts as an ISA and IPEA for international (PCT) applications, implicating international search and preliminary examination standards and timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information resources produced by EAPO
rubrics_metrics.description: The EAPO generates updated information resources of the EAPO, which include: legislative, reference and methodological documentation; patent documentation of the EAPO and the EAPC member States, placed in the databases (DB) of the Eurasian Patent Information System (EAPATIS); Register of Eurasian patents; lists of Eurasian patent attorneys; online forms for filling out application forms and petitions under the Eurasian procedure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EAPO provides authoritative documentation, databases, registers, attorney lists and online application/petition forms to support filing and prosecution under the Eurasian procedure.

rubrics_metrics.name: EAPATIS database support
rubrics_metrics.description: EAPATIS supports more than 40 replenished patent databases, which represent the world, regional and national funds of patent documentation of international organizations and countries included in the minimum documentation of the PCT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EAPATIS is the information system backing searches and documentation; the Russian-language fund is represented by EAPO and national patent offices of the Eurasian region.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination Department and technical divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Examination Department with subdivisions: Formal Examination Division; Chemistry and Medicines Division; Mechanics, Physics and Electrical Engineering Division; Industrial Designs Division; Docflow Management and Control Division, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examination is organized by formal and substantive units and by technical fields, indicating specialization in processing and assessing applications depending on subject-matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Control Center
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality Control Center (Director listed) as a structural unit of EAPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dedicated center indicates institutional QA processes for examination and procedural quality within the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Documents Processing Division
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handles processing of patent documentation — administrative and publication workflows for patent files and documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eurasian Patents Register Division
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintains the official register of Eurasian patents, supporting legal status, publication and records access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Technology Department and search/AI units
rubrics_metrics.description: Information Technology Department with Software Development Division, Search Systems Division, Integration Solutions Division, Cyber Security Division and Center for Artificial Intelligence Implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IT and AI capabilities support search systems, integration, cybersecurity and software for EAPO operations — relevant to search quality and digital processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patenting Promotion Center
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizational unit focused on promoting patenting activities, outreach, and support to applicants and stakeholders.
